name: hologres-query-optimizer
description: Hologres Query Execution Plan Analyzer and Optimizer. Use for analyzing SQL performance issues from query_id, raw SQL, or EXPLAIN ANALYZE text, interpreting query operators, and providing optimization recommendations for Hologres queries. Triggers: "hologres explain", "query plan", "execution plan", "sql optimization", "query performance", "hologres performance", "slow query", "query optimizer", "explain analyze", "query_id"
